message.text:
The server explicitly starts only the s3presign background runner through startBackgroundRunners.

Webhook async workers run via init() in internal/webhook/webhook.go. They are not started by server.Start. They trigger on PostAsync calls from API handlers.

memopayload.Runner exists but is not started by the server. RebuildMemoPayload runs inline during create and update operations.

The server does not start the HTTP server goroutine or the PAT usage goroutine. The latter is on-demand per authentication.

internal/scheduler exists in the codebase but is not imported or used anywhere else. The s3presign runner triggers every 12 hours via time.Ticker and runs once immediately on startup.

The SSE hub does not start persistent workers; it handles requests on demand. File server thumbnail generation uses semaphores on demand.

Focusing on which background workers the server actually starts.

Server.startBackgroundRunners explicitly starts only the s3presign runner. Webhook workers start at process initialization because main imports the webhook package, not through Server.Start(). Both are included as explicitly started runners.

The memopayload Runner exists but is never started as a background worker. Its ruT is only used inline as library functions. The internal/scheduler cron-based job scheduler is unused by production code; it appears only in tests and examples.

q28.

s3presign runner — immediate `RunOnce` on startup, then a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/server.go` → `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)  
webhook async dispatch workers (4 goroutines) — bounded channel queue (`asyncPostQueue`); work is enqueued via `PostAsync` from API handlers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go` `init()`)

Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (cron-based job scheduler in `internal/scheduler/`) is present but not imported or started by the server; only referenced in that package’s tests and docs.

The only background runner explicitly started in `Server.Start` is the S3 presign runner, wired in `server/server.go`:

```153:171:server/server.go
func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
	// ...
	s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
	s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)

	s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
		s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
		slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
	}()
```

It runs once immediately, then every 12 hours via `time.NewTicker` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`.

Webhook workers start at process init (because `cmd/memos/main.go` imports `internal/webhook`), not from `Server.Start`. Four goroutines drain `asyncPostQueue` when handlers call `webhook.PostAsync`.

`server/runner/memopayload` defines a `Runner`, but the server does not start it; only inline `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` calls during memo create/update are used.
